question: The Utkarsh Odisha – Make in Odisha Conclave, 2025, was held at ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhubaneswar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Utkarsh Odisha – Make in Odisha Conclave 2025** is the state's flagship biennial business summit designed to showcase the diverse investment opportunities in **Odisha**.
 
• The **2025** edition of the conclave is scheduled to be held in the capital city, **Bhubaneswar**, specifically at the **Janata Maidan**.
 
• The event is set to take place on **January 28 and 29, 2025**, serving as a platform for global leaders, investors, and policymakers to discuss the state's industrial future.
 
• The **Government of Odisha**, led by Chief Minister **Mohan Charan Majhi**, has rebranded this edition as **Utkarsh Odisha** to reflect the state's aspirations for "prosperous" growth and a **Viksit Odisha** by **2047**.
